title: Dutch Cauliflower Roast
description: A flavorful and delicious side dish, combining the best of Dutch and Roast flavors with the crunch of cauliflower

ingredients.name: roast
ingredients.notes: such as vegetable oil or olive oil

ingredients.name: dutch seasoning
ingredients.notes: such as paprika, garlic powder, onion powder

instructions: Rinse the cauliflower and remove any leaves or stems.
Cut the cauliflower into florets and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle the roast over the cauliflower and sprinkle with Dutch seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Toss the cauliflower to coat evenly with the seasonings and oil.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the cauliflower is tender and lightly browned.
Remove from the oven and serve hot.
